svg.title: Physical board and current full-fit MVP board comparison
svg.desc: Side-by-side full-board views at matched board height: the photographed physical board on the left and a HUD-free 1440 by 900 fit view of the current audited MVP board on the right. The physical photo crop is approximate and perspective remains visible, so this artifact is for human visual review and does not record acceptance.
svg.text: Rendered panel scaled to the approximate physical-board crop height. Photo perspective and edge crop still need reviewer confirmation.
